target_customer: Property managers and real estate operators who need calls and messages answered from tenants and prospects
problem: Property teams miss calls and spend staff time on leasing inquiries, maintenance triage and support. Wayline provides an AI front desk with human property managers as backup.
business_model: B2B SaaS plus human backed call handling (pricing not public; book a demo)
product_category: AI voice and text front desk for real estate

founders.name: Jason Okra
previous_startups: Baker Street (property management, bootstrapped to $1M ARR)
Cribspot (YC W15, team joined Apartmentlist in 2018)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: led WeWork's $110M All-Access business and ran the WeLive coliving product.

founders.name: Eric Rowell
previous_startups: Uiflow (YC W21, raised $21M, acquired by Workday)

competitors.name: Anyone Home by Inhabit
competitors.what: Leasing assistant that added voice AI for prospect calls and tour booking
competitors.traction_then: Exhibited the voice feature at NAA Apartmentalize

competitors.name: EliseAI
competitors.what: Conversational leasing AI integrating with Zillow Rentals listings
competitors.traction_then: Zillow integration expected in the third quarter of 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agents with integrations to AppFolio, Yardi and Entrata are standard engineering with some hard parts around latency, accuracy and handoff to humans.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and a human ops team add some stickiness, but many vendors and property software suites offer similar voice features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Yardi and others shipped voice features in 2025; no source shows a purchase of Wayline.

market_need_then: Property operators had constant inbound call volume and staffing cost, and AI voice became good enough in 2025 for leasing and maintenance triage; incumbents were shipping voice launches at the same time.

branding.domain_note: Uses wayline.com, an exact .com; acquisition details not found.

identity.visual_style: Clean modern layout with warm lifestyle photography and a night skyline
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and people focused: Humans where you need them. AI for everything else.

branding.brand_signature: Humans where you need them. AI for everything else.

brand_strength.rationale: A clear human plus AI positioning line on its site, but no press or community evidence about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Wayline joined YC in Summer 2025 with a founder pair that has property management and prior YC and exit experience. It sells an AI plus human front desk to property managers with named operator customers on its site. No exit or shutdown was found and funding detail is limited to aggregator reports, so the outcome is still open.
notes: Unverified: aggregators (Caplight, PitchBook, Crustdata, VCBacked) report about $500K in August or September 2025 from YC, Pioneer Fund, Rebel Fund and others; type given as seed by one and pre-seed by others. No primary release, so no round is recorded. EliseAI source date is approximate (article says expected third quarter 2025). A product named Operator is reported by one directory only. Completeness pass: the 2025-09 pre-seed of 500K rests on a single database (VCBacked; Standout agrees on total and stage but is not independent). No press confirmation found.
